title: test(cutover-prep F): ui tests pay the first load of the specifiers check:test-source-alias names at module scope (objectstack#25763)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoHZM3TyZPr2yRmDU4cH4TJH)_

Part of objectstack#25763 (cutover prep F of the objectui → objectstack `ui/` merge). Part of objectstack#25677.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

In the merged tree every `@objectstack/*` import in a ui test resolves to a workspace package's `dist`, so a first load paid inside a test body, a `vi.mock` factory or after `vi.resetModules()` bills a cold transform to a clocked window (verify runs 8 and 11 reddened Test UI 3/16 on exactly this shape). objectstack's `check:test-source-alias` names these sites.

Each of the 26 files below now also loads the same specifier with a module-scope side-effect import, so the transform is paid during collection, which vitest clocks against nothing. Every dynamic import stays where it was: this only decides where the first load is paid. No timeout is widened, nothing is skipped, and no production code changes. The changeset is empty-frontmatter (test-only, releases nothing).

The 30 findings fall in three shapes, each with its own one-line comment in the file:

- **in a test body or a helper a test awaits** (13 files): `@objectstack/spec`, `spec/ui`, `spec/data`, `spec/api`, `spec/kernel`, `spec/system`, `spec/security`, `spec/integration`, `@objectstack/formula`, `@object-ui/components`;
- **inside a `vi.mock` factory** (10 files): `@object-ui/i18n/locales`, `@object-ui/react`, `@object-ui/components`;
- **re-imported after each `vi.resetModules()`** (3 files, `@object-ui/core`): the reset re-evaluates, but the transform is cached, so warming it once moves the compile out of every clocked re-import.

`DraftChangesPanel.securityProblems.test.tsx` is 2c round 2 (a)'s (objectstack#25727) and is not touched; the gate does not list it on this tree either.

## Gate reading on the merged layout

Verify branch `claude/project-thread-dwhq6r-25697-verify` head `9e37acd126`, this diff applied with `git apply --directory=ui` (applies clean: all 33 named files are byte-identical between that tree's `ui/` and objectui `main` `0063f22ce`). `node scripts/check-test-source-alias.mjs`:

| | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| function-body lines printed under `ui/` | 57 | 12 |
| unique (file, specifier) findings | 37 | 7 |
| real findings (a runtime load) | 30 | **0** |
| every other line of the gate's output | — | byte-identical to before |

### Gate false positives, left untouched (see objectstack#25766)

These 7 never load anything at run time, so there is no cost to warm; adding a side-effect import would add a load these files do not pay today. The gate reads them because its type-query check knows only `typeof`, and its import pattern runs over a projection that still holds string content.

- `packages/plugin-calendar/src/__tests__/spec-symbol-4650.test.ts`, type alias under a `@ts-expect-error` tripwire
- `packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/spec-symbol-4650.test.ts`, same
- `packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/spec-symbol-4650.test.ts`, same
- `packages/plugin-kanban/src/__tests__/spec-symbol-4650.test.ts`, same (the four headers explain why the inline type-level form is deliberate)
- `packages/types/src/__tests__/dashboard-global-filters-spec-binding.test.ts`, type alias
- `packages/components/src/renderers/complex/__tests__/data-table.test.ts`, type annotation
- `scripts/__tests__/check-spec-range-floors.test.ts`, text inside a template-literal fixture

Both before and after: 26 files, 342 tests, all passed.

| | merged before | merged after | standalone before | standalone after |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| vitest "tests" (summed across files, s) | 173.88 | 164.70 | 161.17 | 151.87 |
| vitest "import" (collection, s) | 175.03 | 190.95 | 133.82 | 138.96 |
| wall duration (s) | 135.99 | 138.08 | 117.33 | 114.44 |

The remaining 1.9 s is not a load the gate attributes to this file, so this card leaves it alone (not investigated further).
